# Kpler & GrowthBook | Enterprise Setup Conversation
Date: 2026-09-16 | Duration: 56m

## Summary
The Lufthansa RFP remains ongoing, with answers needed by tomorrow, while overlapping meetings with the Capilla team created scheduling conflicts. The team discussed heavy feature-flag usage and limited experimentation, noting that internal users currently rely on frontend overrides to toggle flags individually. This workaround lacks a backend source of truth, and a client SDK feature for patching flag values per user is missing. There is interest in moving from Pro to Enterprise by October 31; Enterprise includes SSO, SAML, stable pricing, and training support. The Pro plan’s pricing will change soon, with a grandfathering period available, but internal budget approval and stakeholder alignment are still needed, primarily through Rémi Becheras. Marcel will send a summary email and pricing examples the next day. A follow-up with PMs and the customer success head is planned for October 24 afternoon to clarify feature flags, experimentation workflow, and adoption support. Philippe can help coordinate SSO internally.

## Keywords
feature flagging, GrowthBook, enterprise plan, experimentation, SSO, seat usage

## Action Items
**Rémi Becheras**  
Discuss experimentation goals internally (32:11)  
Investigate seat usage at Kpler (32:11)  
Decide on supporting individual user toggling (27:47)  
Confirm GrowthBook budget owner (35:22)  

**Marcel Geldner**  
Investigate individual user toggling with GrowthBook (25:37)  
Discuss toggling priority with GrowthBook founders (35:47)  
Provide Enterprise pricing examples (36:41)  
Send summary email to Kpler (38:34)
